description: This file defines the ImpactProjectItemCostTransformer class, which extends AbstractTransformer and provides methods to retrieve cost-related data and generate related action URLs within the impact project management context.

classes.name: ImpactProjectItemCostTransformer
classes.description: A transformer class for handling cost data associated with impact project items, including retrieval of cost IDs, names, and generating delete URLs.

methods.name: getCostId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the cost associated with the model.

methods.name: getCostName
methods.description: Returns the name of the cost related to the model.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an array with action URLs for the impact project item cost, such as the delete URL.
